_comment: Synthetic example demonstrating /api/incidents.schema.v1.json. All entries are illustrative; none are real events. Validates against incidents.schema.v1.json. Real /api/incidents.json may contain a subset of the entries shown here (e.g. an empty incidents array when no events have been recorded).

incidents.title: Monitoring reliability regression (example)
incidents.summary: Example entry. Operator-notification path degraded; records reviewed do not indicate validator-side impact. potentiallyAffectedStartStatus=undetermined because the start of the affected window could not be reconstructed from records reviewed.

incidents.title: Example: planned web host migration
incidents.summary: Example entry. Planned web host migration with announced window; validator itself unaffected. potentiallyAffectedStartStatus=not_applicable because the maintenance was scoped to web and had no operator-impacting start.

incidents.title: Example: DR drill tabletop exercise
incidents.summary: Example entry. Tabletop walk-through of docs/DISASTER_RECOVERY.md scenario A. potentiallyAffectedStartStatus=known with the date matching the drill day.
